transcript: Speaker A (AI): काय करत आहेस? [What are you doing?] Speaker B (Human): I am painting my... म्हणजे हो, I am painting my face. [I am painting my... [But I don't get time.] Speaker A (AI): रोज फक्त १०-१५ मिनिटे प्रॅक्टिस पुरेशी आहे. अगदी confident व्हाल. [Just 10-15 minutes of practice daily is enough. You will become very confident.] Speaker B (Human): Wow! कसं join करू? [Wow! How do I join?] Speaker A (AI): हा install चा button दाबा आणि MySivi app install करा.
